title: Noise sensitivity bound for a Boolean class
statement: Let $B=(B_r)_{r\geq0}$ be a class of sign-valued functions on finite sign cubes, closed under negating input coordinates and under identifying input coordinates. Suppose $A$ assigns a real number to each positive integer $r$, and every $g\in B_r$ has total influence at most $A(r)$. For any nonnegative integer $n$, any $f\in B_n$, and any $0<\delta\leq\tfrac12$, the probability that $f$ changes when each coordinate of a uniformly chosen input is independently flipped with probability $\delta$ is at most $A(m)/m$, where $m=\lfloor1/\delta\rfloor$.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is closed under negating input coordinates
$B$ is closed under identifying input coordinates
$A$ is defined on positive integers and is real-valued
Every member of $B_r$ has total influence at most $A(r)$
